findings.title: Keep replay ownership guards after disabling routing
findings.proof: A restored fast-owned encrypted reasoning item reaches different-model through a public request listener when routing is absent. The routing-enabled control blocks it.

findings.title: Finalize suspended structured runs using effective restored options

findings.title: Bind native compaction after choosing the managed route
findings.proof: An unsupported unused default prevents construction despite a supported explicitly authorized alternative; supplying a default adapter makes the same alternative work.
findings.fix: Defer routed native binding to execution selection while preserving checkpoint and idle-maintenance owners.
